annotations.title: Run the deterministic Lal Kitab inference kernel

description: Calculates a topic-aware Lal Kitab natal prediction and remedy plan from fixed houses, conjunction friendship/enmity, dormancy, eclipse conditions and birth-period context. It reasons from calculated chart facts without searching the corpus at runtime and returns a complete explanation trace; annual timing is not implied.

place.description: Catalogue query or display label when explicit coordinates are supplied

timezone.description: Required IANA timezone when explicit coordinates are supplied, for example Asia/Kolkata

timezoneOffset.description: Optional fallback offset; derived from timezone and the requested local date when omitted
